title: Fixed-width types, size_t, and ptrdiff_t

spans.text: `uint8_t`, `uint16_t`, `uint32_t`, `uint64_t`, and `int8_t`, `int16_t`, `int32_t` state their bit width explicitly. `size_t` is for array sizes and indexes; `ptrdiff_t` is a signed distance between elements in the same array. Since `int` size varies by board, fixed-width types make protocol fields more predictable.

spans.title: Important note
spans.text: Wider types can use more memory; choose the smallest type that fits. Account for overflow and remember that `size_t` is unsigned. `uint64_t` arithmetic may be slower on small boards.
